decisions.what: Appended hero section styles before the prefers-reduced-motion media query in styles.css
decisions.why: Preserved the existing token/reset structure at the top of the file and kept the reduced-motion query at the end so it still overrides transitions on newly added hero elements.

decisions.what: Applied hero CTA styling to both .cta-button and the existing .btn-primary inside .hero
decisions.why: index.html uses .btn.btn-primary for the hero CTA rather than a .cta-button class; scoping CTA rules to .hero ensures the specified visuals apply to actual markup without leaking to other buttons.

decisions.what: Implemented pixel-aesthetic decoration via radial-gradient dot pattern on .hero::before/::after plus a .pixel-pattern CSS Grid utility (grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, 40px), gap: 40px, opacity 0.1, z-index -1)
decisions.why: Spec calls for pixel-aesthetic patterns and a CSS Grid pixel pattern; providing both the decorative pseudo-element pattern (rendered without extra markup) and the reusable .pixel-pattern grid class satisfies both requirements.

decisions.what: Used clip-path polygon() with rotate(60deg) on hero pseudo-elements to form the 60-degree angle visual device
decisions.why: Matches the specified 60-degree angle device requirement using CSS-only decorative layers with no image dependencies (forbidden by available_imports).

decisions.what: Added mobile breakpoints at 768px and 480px reducing padding, font sizes, and stacking hero actions vertically
decisions.why: Explicit requirement for mobile responsiveness with reduced padding and font sizes on smaller screens.
